proof:
by
  intro x hx
  have hxi := Set.mem_Icc.mp hx
  rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have hxa : |x| ≤ |μ| + 2 * Real.sqrt v := by
    rw [abs_le]
    exact ⟨by linarith [neg_abs_le μ], by linarith [le_abs_self μ]⟩
  calc t * x ≤ |t * x| := le_abs_self _
    _ = |t| * |x| := abs_mul t x
    _ ≤ |t| * (|μ| + 2 * Real.sqrt v) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxa (abs_nonneg t)
